m12: He bounces hard on bent knees and jabs his finger at the camera on every stressed word, leaning closer each time, then snaps his head sideways and back as if daring the viewer to look away.
s01: He prowls fast down the alley toward the camera, rolling his shoulders on each step and flinging his arms out on the beat, then stops dead close to the lens and throws both hands open as if asking why now.
s02: He drives up out of the crouch onto his toes, swings his free arm from the far-off door back to the camera with a hard downward chop on "poor" and "door", and bounces on bent knees through the firelight.
s03: He jumps on every beat with his fist pumping skyward, strutting in a tight sneering circle between hops, and jabs the other finger down at the city lights as if they were the man he is mocking.
s04: He brings the free arm down like a hammer on "tick", "tank", "steel" and "meal deal", stamping his front foot with each blow and nodding his head sharply on the downbeat, faster and harder as the line builds.
s05: Fast and aggressive, he bounces hard on bent knees to the beat, stabbing his finger at the lens on every stressed word, then springs up and throws his arm straight above his head on "change"; static camera.
s06: Energetic movement throughout, he prowls quickly along the wall with heavy planted steps, swings the door arm wide, then stops dead and jabs the cupped hand at the camera three times in rhythm on "can I fucking have some more"; static camera.
t04: Fast-paced and contemptuous, he struts side to side along the glass, his flat palm chopping down hard like a gavel on every rhyme, head snapping toward the camera on "pathetic" and "paralytic"; static camera.
t03: Big and theatrical, he rocks forward over the table on the beat, swinging his pointing arm down at the lens like a hammer on "bum" and "sorrow", then throws it out wide toward the diners on "tomorrow comes"; static camera.
t05: He swaggers forward along the deck bouncing on bent knees, then stops dead and jabs his free index finger down at the lens on every stressed word, static camera.
t06: Aggressive and fast throughout, he advances on the camera kicking up sand, both hands jabbing at the lens on each word, then flings his arms wide in disgust, static camera.
t07: He rocks hard on the raised knee to the beat, snapping the card down like a hammer on each rhyme, then hops off the bumper and turns his empty pockets out toward the camera, static camera.
t08: He bounces on the chair, pumping the champagne flute up on every beat as the guests copy him with their glasses, then leans out over the pool toward the lens on the punchline, static camera.
